name: What home repairs should I fix first before they turn into a bigger problem?

mainEntity.name: What home repairs should I fix first before they turn into a bigger problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small home repairs are usually worth handling right away if they involve water, electrical issues, loose fixtures, or damage that can spread. Waiting often turns a minor fix into a bigger, more expensive problem, especially with leaks, drafts, or exterior openings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fix leaks, electrical issues, loose fixtures, and any damage that can spread first. Small problems often become much more expensive if you wait.
